title: Rural Home Loans Escrow Waiver Fee Rate Bands by Loan-to-Value
content:
Pricing schedule of the escrow waiver fee rate on Rural Home Loans by loan-to-value, measured against the waiver value.

## Bands

The fee rate depends on the loan-to-value ratio, the principal balance divided by the waiver value as a percentage rounded to two decimals, the waiver value being the value the escrow waiver loan-to-value limit is applied to, namely the lower of the home's original value and the appraised value recorded when the homesite was released from a farm real estate mortgage as a farmstead split, or for a homesite larger than 20 acres not so released the original value less 5 percent, or otherwise the original value: above 77.5, the rate is 0.4 percent; above 70.0 and up to 77.5, it is 0.35 percent; at or below 70.0, it is the product's escrow waiver fee percentage.

| Loan-to-value against the waiver value | Fee rate |
|---|---|
| above 77.5 | 0.4 percent |
| above 70.0, up to and including 77.5 | 0.35 percent |
| 70.0 or below | the product's escrow waiver fee percentage |

## The waiver value

| Homesite | Waiver value |
|---|---|
| released from a Farm Real Estate Loans mortgage as a farmstead split | the lower of the original value and the appraised value recorded at that release |
| not so released, more than 20 acres | the original value less 5 percent of it |
| not so released, 20 acres or fewer | the original value |

The release is read from the Farm Real Estate Loans parcel records for the homesite's county parcel number; the acreage and original value from the loan record.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, waiver value 300000.00)

| Principal balance | Loan-to-value | Fee rate |
|---|---|---|
| 232500.00 | 77.50 | 0.35 percent |
| 232530.00 | 77.51 | 0.4 percent |
| 210000.00 | 70.00 | the product's escrow waiver fee percentage |
| 210030.00 | 70.01 | 0.35 percent |
| 232512.00 | 77.504, rounded to 77.50 | 0.35 percent |
